questions.question: Whose words are recorded in Proverbs 30?
What does Agur ask God for regarding wealth?
options: Great power and rule over a very wide and well-peopled land
Riches far greater than those of all his neighbors round about
Neither poverty nor riches, but only the food needful for him
Endless heaps of gold and silver to last him all of his days
questions.answer: Neither poverty nor riches, but only the food needful for him

questions.question: Proverbs 30 lists four things that are small but exceedingly wise, including the ant.
Give me neither poverty nor _____, but feed me with the food that is needful for me.
Every word of God proves true; he is a _____ to those who take refuge in him.
